milestones.title: Current professional role and context described
milestones.description: The practitioner has described their current role, context, and professional situation.

milestones.title: Initial self-reflection across development dimensions
milestones.description: The practitioner has reflected on their perceived strengths and objectives across the six development dimensions.

milestones.title: First real workplace situation brought to coaching
milestones.description: The practitioner has described a real Change Management situation using the observation sequence.

milestones.title: Reflection on decision, behavior, and outcome
milestones.description: The practitioner has reflected on their interpretation, approach, behavior, and the outcome of a situation.

milestones.title: Multiple observations connected
milestones.description: The practitioner has connected two or more observations and explored whether a pattern is emerging.

milestones.title: Pattern hypothesis validated collaboratively
milestones.description: A pattern hypothesis has been explored and validated or adjusted with the practitioner.

milestones.title: Focused development area selected
milestones.description: The practitioner has selected one focused development area based on observed patterns.

milestones.title: Small real-work experiment committed
milestones.description: The practitioner has committed to a small, real-world experiment that can be applied in the workplace.

milestones.title: Experiment revisited and outcome described
milestones.description: The practitioner has revisited their experiment and described what happened.

milestones.title: Learning recorded and next action decided
milestones.description: The practitioner has identified what they learned and decided whether to retain, adapt, or abandon the approach.

milestones.title: Accumulated experiences reviewed
milestones.description: The practitioner has reviewed accumulated experiences to identify demonstrated development.

milestones.title: Next development priority established
milestones.description: The practitioner has updated development priorities and established the next deliberate-practice focus.
